summary.text: Bryson Johnson is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a cybersecurity engineer and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Bryson Johnson earned a high school diploma from Augusta Christian Schools, a bachelor's degree from Campbell University, and a graduate degree from the EC-Council in 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has owned a business in the district for more than 20 years, that he held a Top Secret clearance while supporting U.S. Special Operations as a contractor, and that he kept his staff employed during the COVID-19 shutdowns.
Johnson advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, which was canceled.
In the survey, he said he would work to expand mental health care access and funding, increase teacher pay and reinstate master's pay, and pursue affordability and a competitive business climate.
